content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
wunɛ Bɛtelehɛmu, Efɑrɑtɑɡibun wuu,
wunɑ ɑ piiburu bo Yudɑn wusu sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ wunɛn min diyɑ kpɑro koo yɑri
wi u koo nɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ kpɑrɑ.
U wɑ̃ɑwɑ sɑɑ yee yellun di.
Adɑmɑ ko nɑ n ɡinɑ nɛn tɔn be deriwɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑn nɔmɑ sɔɔ
sere kurɔ wì u koo kpɑro wi mɑ, u kɑ mɑ.
Be bɑ kpikiru dɑ, bɑ koo ɡɔsirɑmɑ bu Isireli be bɑ tie deemɑ.
Kpɑ kpɑro wi nɑ bɛɛ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ mi,
u bɛɛ nɛn tɔmbu mɛnnɑ u kpɑrɑ mɑm mɑm
kɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn dɑm kɑ nɛn yiiko.
Win tɔmbu bɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
Kpɑ u yĩsiru yɑri hɑnduniɑn ɡoonu nnɛ ye sɔɔ.
Wiyɑ u koo kɑ bɔri yɛndu nɑ.
Asiriɡibu bɑ̀ n nɑ, bɑ bɛsɛn tem wɔri
bɑ duɑ sere bɛsɛn sinɑ kpɑɑrɔ,
sɑ ko bɛsɛn kpɑro be bɑ dɑm bo seeyɑ bu bu wɔri.
Ben tɑbu yɑ̃nun sɔ̃,
bɑ koo Asiriɡibu kɑ Nimuroduɡii be tɑɑre,
kpɑ bu sun wɔrɑ Asiriɡibu bɑ̀ n bɛsɛn tem wɔrimɑ.

content: bwese ni nu tien suunu sɔɔ

content.text: Isireli be bɑ tiɑrɑ bɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ tɔn dɑbinun suunu sɔɔ nɡe kɑko ɑrufɑɑniɡiru
te Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ tɑ wɔrumɑ,
ǹ kun mɛ nɡe ɡurɑ ye yɑ nɛmɔ tɛɛru,
yɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu yĩiyɔ tɔnun min di.
Isireli be bɑ tiɑrɑ bɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ tɔmbun suunu sɔɔ,
kpɑ bɑ n dɑm mɔ nɡe ɡbee sunɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛn suunu sɔɔ,
ǹ kun mɛ yɑ̃ɑ ɡɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ.
Mi ɡɑ duɑ kpuro, ɡɑ rɑ yɑɑ kɑsukuwɑ ɡu mwɛ.
Goo kun mɑɑ kpɛ̃ u ɡu mwɑɑri.
Isirelibɑ, i seewo i bɛɛn yibɛrɛbɑ wɔri.
Kpɑ i bu ɡo mɑm mɑm.
Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
tɔ̃ru ɡɑrɑ sisi tè sɔɔ kon bɛɛn dumi kɑ bɛɛn tɑbu kɛkɛbɑ kpeerɑsiɑ.
Kpɑ n bɛɛn wusu kɑm koosiɑ.
Kpɑ n bɛɛn ɡbɑ̃rɑnu suriri.
Kon bɛɛn dobo doboɡibu ɡo.
I ǹ mɑɑ ben dobo dobo wɑsi bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ.
Kon bwɑ̃ɑrokunu kɑ kpee ni i ɡirɑ kɔsuku.
I ǹ mɑɑ nu sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Kon bũu wi bɑ mɔ̀ Asitɑɑten sɑ̃ɑ yerun dɑ̃nu wukiri.
Kpɑ n bɛɛn wusu kɔsuku.
Nɛn mɔru koo se,
kpɑ n nɛn dɑm sɔ̃ɔsi bwese ni nu ǹ mɑn mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛn mi.
